title: The pilgrimage spots: public places by name, address and coordinates, and what to say there
description: Place names only: no story details, screenshots, character art, quotes or logos. Which scene a spot is stays the learner's own note on the phone.

phraseRef.description: A lesson phrase id (L23-01) or the id of a phrase in this file.

status.description: draft → checked (cross-checked) → native (native speaker) → audio_ok (audio listened to)

checkedText.description: The Italian text as it was when it was marked checked or later; must equal it unless status is draft.

commonPhrases.description: Lesson phrases for any spot, such as asking someone to take a photo.

phrases.description: Sentences for the spots that aren't lesson phrases; lesson phrases are reused by id.

city.description: A city id in course.json; for a day trip, the city it is made from.

dayTrip.description: Reached on a day trip from the city rather than in it.

it.description: The name in Italian, as signposted and said.

note.description: Help with saying the name, in Chinese.

pin.description: For a place larger than a point: what the pin marks, in Chinese.
